title: Ye Kehta Hua Doob
body:
ye kehta hua doob gaya subho ka taara
aaj uth gaya dunya se ghareebon ka sahara
<<DIVIDER>>
kufe mein ye ghul hai ke zamane se sidhara
bewaon ka nigehban yateemon ka sahara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaayi hai udaasi dar o deewar e haram par
dooba hai wo emaan ka pur noor sitara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
mayyat pe hassan aur hussain ka ye bayan tha
baba nahi dunya mein to phir kaun hamara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye shaan to dekhe koi allah ke ghar se
allah ke ghar jaata hai allah ka pyara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
uneeswi ki subho qayamat se nahi kam
haye sar e hyder hua sajde mein do paara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ne kaha phir mujhe ek baar dikha do
ab laut ke aayenge nahi baba dobara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos ke khud doob gaya apne lahoo mein
wo jisne ke islam ki kashti ko ubhaara
ye kehta hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
sharib na rahe iske liye phir koi mushkil
jis ne dam e mushkil mere maula ko pukara
ye kehta hua...
author: Sharib
